title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalam alikum, Please Help Me Out. I did a shopping of rs. 50000/ with credit card, later on i converted that amount as EMI for 3 months, it is 0% interest (Interest free), and service charge of 2%. Is this legal? Jazakallah! 3619 views Q. Assalamu alaikum wa rahamatullahi wa barakatuhu! Jazakallahu khairan for the taking the initiative of reviving Islam ( through Tableeghi works and other activities). I was going through your reply for question 1471 Faiths & Beliefs Deviant Sects & Groups ( Link : http://darulifta-deoband.com/viewfatwa.jsp?ID=1 471 ) ( You have answered many questions in the same manner for e.g. 6516 Faiths & Beliefs Dawah & Tableeg) Instead of directing the questioner to the refutation book or some other source - it would be very helpful in clearing the misconception if the answer is provided then and there itself. This will save a lot of effort and time. We write to you scholars because we are not competent enough in Isalmic education - that we will ourselves sit and refer to each book and find out the details ourselves. I have learnt in Jamath that of the 6 adab, one is to acquire knowledge by asking. What is the ruling regarding selling of items at higher price e.g an item XYZ costs Rs : 100/- and I sell it at 10,000/-. Is this allowed? (Kinldy quote references) Awaiting your response. May Allah reward you for the righteous deeds. Ameen. 2546 views Q. In a business there are 2 partners,One partner who invest money and the second partner finds business(work) only,they share profit as follows partner who invest 75% and partner who finds work 25%,if there is a loss in the work does the partner who only finds work has to bear the loss in above mentioned ratio or he is partner in profit only? Nothing was discussed to share in loss. 2045 views Q. Houses construction business 2723 views Q. One day i bought a miswak from a roadside seller outside a masjid but the salesman was not available so another customer told me to select the miswak i like and to keep the money in his cash so i did what he said as i was in a hurry but afterwards i thought was it according to shariah or not? 1653 views Q. Computer business. 1811 views Q. Selling parfume for ladies 2113 views Q. A customer has given me order of match boxes of 100,000 rupees. He has also done advance payment of 15,000 rupees. At present i have made goods of worth 25,000 rupees , but now customer says to cancel the order and refund the money. If i sell this goods in open market then there will be a loss around 10,000 rs , that is , i will get 15,000 (25,000 - 10,000= 15,000). In case i agree to cancel the order with customer, then can i keep his 10,000 rupees with me to compensate my loss, and refund him 5,000 (15,000 - 10,000=5000) ?. Please reply in detail and along with proof . 1725 views Q. Ruling about business and property division among brothers 1646 views Q. I am going to start a new business with my friend both have agreed to invest 50% amount by each and to share the profit in the same percentage 2329 views Q. If my husband's earning is low and we are "unable" to give Zakah or pay rent regularly or give Sadaqah whole heartedly, can I operate a business from home and say to him that we will share the earnings. Is this right? 1781 views Q. I have 21 years old son from my first marriage, who lives with me and goes to college. My first husband has passed away. I have married to a married man has his own family. He lives with his family, but comes every week. I had a business from my first marriage and now my husband runs it. So far I have worked and paid all the bills. Now I am not working from four months, my husband says that what ever I made belongs to him. He denies giving it to my son. Is this right by Islamic way? Please send me your fatwa for this situation. May Allah reward you for this? 2519 views Q. Property Dispute 1812 views Q. CCTV Business - Halal Or Haram 4739 views Q. sharing profits 3012 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 21712 Country: Canada Title: I am in Canada.I want to lease a gas/petrol pum from the oil company.According to the rule of this country you are bound to sale lottery tickets in gas station.Can i lease the station with the intention of not getting the income of lottery tickets. Question: I am in Canada.I want to lease a gas/petrol pum from the oil company.According to the rule of this country you are bound to sale lottery tickets in gas station.Can i lease the station with the intention of not getting the income of lottery tickets. Answer ID: 21712 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 752/515/L=1431) Selling lottery tickets is unlawful and haram. So taking such a petrol pump on lease where selling of lottery tickets is necessary will be unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
